stdyInfo.abstract: Paper-and-pencil questionnaire for evaluating vocational training courses from the participants' point of view. Its 45 statements, rated on a five-point agreement scale, cover five training outcome dimensions (fun, usefulness, difficulty, knowledge growth, attitude towards the training) and five training design dimensions (problem-based learning, activation, demonstration, application, integration). It was developed with team trainings at a European airline and a German fire brigade; bracketed parts of the items are adapted to the course type and content before use.

sumDscr.universe: Teilnehmende beruflicher Trainings ab 18 Jahren (Berufstätige); auch 16-jährige Auszubildende
